title: Server Administrator
description:
**Company Description** 
 Gozo is a travel technology company transforming how people travel between cities across India. With service coverage in over 6,000 towns and cities, Gozo operates a large network of chauffeured cabs focused on comfort, affordability, and quality. The platform aggregates vetted cab providers nationwide to match customer demand with reliable operators who deliver service with transparency and trust. Gozo’s vision is to be the most trusted travel experience provider in India, creating personalized and memorable trips for both business and leisure travelers. The company emphasizes pre\-screened drivers, commercially licensed vehicles, and strong repeat customer rates driven by consistent service quality.
 



**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Server Administrator role based in the Kolkata metropolitan area. The Server Administrator will manage and maintain server and system infrastructure supporting Gozo’s travel technology platform, including installation, configuration, monitoring, and performance optimization. Daily responsibilities include handling system updates and patches, ensuring data security and backups, monitoring system health, and resolving technical issues to minimize downtime. The role involves close collaboration with development and operations teams to support deployments, troubleshoot production incidents, and improve reliability and scalability. The Server Administrator will also document procedures, implement best practices, and provide technical support to internal stakeholders.
 



**Qualifications** 



* Strong Server Administration skills, including installation, configuration, monitoring, and performance optimization of server environments.
* Solid System Administration experience managing user accounts, permissions, backups, and system security across multiple environments.
* Proficient in Troubleshooting and Technical Support, with the ability to diagnose and resolve hardware, software, and network\-related issues.
* Hands\-on experience with Operating Systems (such as Linux/Unix and Windows Server) and familiarity with scripting or automation tools.
* Understanding of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, firewalls, VPNs) and basic database administration concepts.
* Ability to work on\-site in the Kolkata metropolitan area, collaborate with cross\-functional teams, and communicate technical information clearly.
* Relevant certifications (e.g., Linux, Windows Server, or cloud platforms) and experience in high\-availability or cloud\-based environments are a plus.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

 We are seeking an experienced and knowledgeable Senior Consultant for Entra SSO Operations to join our team. * Experience with App Registration and Enterprise applications
* Conduct regular security reviews and audits of Entra SSO configurations to ensure alignment with industry standards and compliance requirements and recommend improvements as necessary.
* Drive the implementation of Multi\-Factor Authentication (MFA) policies across the organization to enhance security posture and user experience.
* Collaborate with IT and security teams to refine and enforce access control policies, ensuring the principle of least privilege is maintained and compliance is achieved.
* Manage the resolution of tickets and service requests related to Entra SSO, prioritizing based on impact and urgency, and mentoring junior staff in troubleshooting techniques.
* Stay updated on new Entra SSO features and updates, participating in relevant training and knowledge\-sharing sessions to maintain expertise in the platform and share insights with the team.
* Provide strategic feedback and suggestions to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the Entra SSO service, including identifying automation opportunities and process enhancements.
* Drive the automation and optimization of operational processes to enhance system reliability and reduce manual workload.
* Mentor junior operations analysts and contribute to the development of training materials and best practices


**Preferred Skills:**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience); master’s degree is a plus.
* 5\+ years of experience in IT operations or support, with a focus on identity and access management, specifically with Entra SSO or similar platforms.
* Strong understanding of security protocols and standards (e.g., SAML, OAuth, OpenID Connect) and their application in SSO environments.
* Proven experience in leading operational initiatives and managing complex technical issues.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to convey technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Experience in consulting role is preferred, with a track record of delivering high\-quality service to clients.
* Relevant certifications such as Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate, ITIL, or similar


**Education:**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.


**Work Requirements:**
* Willingness to travel as required
* Willingness to be on call support engineer and work occasional overtime as required
* Willingness to work in shifts as required
